political_impact.text: Sharretts's commission carried out the tariff article of the Boxer Protocol, converting ad valorem duties on imports into China to specific duties to fund the indemnity.

political_impact.text: The Circle, Sitka and Yukon land districts and their offices at Rampart City, Sitka and St. Michael were discontinued as of May 31, 1902, and the single Juneau Land District for all of Alaska opened on June 2.

legacy.text: The naval reservation on Adak and Kiska anticipated the strategic weight those Aleutian islands would carry four decades later.

reception.text: None of the 1901–1902 unnumbered orders drew recorded press attention.

political_impact.text: The orders were the ordinary paperwork of a working presidency: land offices, reservations at home and overseas, Navy pay and individual civil-service cases.
